name: collie
description: Collie's IDE entrance — start or supervise Missions, inspect scoped evidence and diffs, and share one runtime with desktop, terminal, and phone.

collie.command.description: Path to the collie CLI (must be on PATH, or an absolute path). Machine-scoped so an untrusted workspace cannot override the spawned command (RCE guard).

collie.port.description: Port for the managed `collie web` server. 0 = auto-pick a free port.

collie.provider.description: Override COLLIE_PROVIDER for the server (blank = collie's own default, e.g. anthropic-oauth). Machine-scoped so an untrusted workspace cannot override it (RCE guard).

collie.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to `collie web`. Machine-scoped so an untrusted workspace cannot inject args into the spawned command (RCE guard).
